pr_body:
This commit removes the specific index settings used to resize indices during clone/split/shrink.

Settings are removed once all primary shards are started. This is implemented in a new `RoutingChangesObserver` in order to not add more complexity to the existing `IndexMetadataUpdater`.

Closes #90127

Edit:  Sadly ILM relies on the `INDEX_RESIZE_SOURCE_NAME_KEY` setting to identify an index that has been shrunk. I suppose this information was not added to ILM lifecycle execution state to keep it minimal but it now makes this change harder to implement. I've updated the code to not remove this index settings for ILM managed indices but I would prefer ILM to maintain its own metadata in its execution state, specially when an information is required after the ILM action is done.
pr_title: Remove resize index settings once shards are started
